SpPrAn documentation

SpPrAn (Spatial Proteomics Analysis) is a Python pipeline for analyzing single-cell spatial proteomics data exported from Visiopharm®. Cells are classified using user-defined protein-marker rules and can be organized into hierarchical cell populations and subtypes.

SpPrAn can be run from Python/the command line or from a packaged desktop application for users who prefer a graphical workflow.

Note

SpPrAn assigns marker-defined phenotypes. Biological specificity depends on the antibody panel, tissue context, segmentation strategy, staining performance, and upstream positivity thresholds.
